description: Connects human genetic variants to compounds through genotype-level ClinPGx/PharmGKB pharmacogenomic annotations provided by the Open Targets Platform. The association retains the annotated genotype, phenotype, evidence level and structured effects.

common_properties.name: ot_pgx_annotation_ids
common_properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index i refers to the same entry.

common_properties.name: ot_pgx_genotypes
common_properties.description: Genotypes described by the pharmacogenomic annotations, for example AG.
common_properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index i refers to the same entry. Missing text values → "NA".

common_properties.name: ot_pgx_variant_ids
common_properties.description: Open Targets allele-specific variant identifiers for the supporting annotations.
common_properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index i refers to the same entry. "NA" for rsID-only rows.

common_properties.name: ot_pgx_evidence_levels
common_properties.description: Evidence levels reported for the annotations: 1A, 1B, 2A, 2B, 3 or 4.
common_properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index i refers to the same entry. Missing text values → "NA".

common_properties.name: ot_pgx_categories
common_properties.description: Pharmacogenomic categories: efficacy, toxicity, metabolism/pk, dosage, pd or other.
common_properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index i refers to the same entry. Missing text values → "NA".

common_properties.name: ot_pgx_phenotypes
common_properties.description: Free-text pharmacogenomic phenotypes, for example decreased response.
common_properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index i refers to the same entry. Missing text values → "NA".

common_properties.name: ot_pgx_directions
common_properties.description: Directionality of the structured pharmacogenomic effects.
common_properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index i refers to the same entry. Fields that are themselves multi-valued within one entry are stored as one string with values joined by "|", in source order. The three structured properties keep the variantAnnotation items of one annotation in the same order, so position k inside the joined strings refers to the same item across ot_pgx_directions, ot_pgx_effects and ot_pgx_compared_alleles. "NA" when no variantAnnotation; an item without value → NA inside the joined string.

common_properties.name: ot_pgx_effects
common_properties.description: Structured pharmacogenomic effects, for example response to or risk of.
common_properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index i refers to the same entry. Fields that are themselves multi-valued within one entry are stored as one string with values joined by "|", in source order. The three structured properties keep the variantAnnotation items of one annotation in the same order, so position k inside the joined strings refers to the same item across ot_pgx_directions, ot_pgx_effects and ot_pgx_compared_alleles. "NA" when no variantAnnotation; an item without value → NA inside the joined string.

common_properties.name: ot_pgx_compared_alleles
common_properties.description: Alleles or genotypes compared by the annotation, expressed as base allele or genotype vs comparison allele or genotype, for example A vs G.
common_properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index i refers to the same entry. Fields that are themselves multi-valued within one entry are stored as one string with values joined by "|", in source order. The three structured properties keep the variantAnnotation items of one annotation in the same order, so position k inside the joined strings refers to the same item across ot_pgx_directions, ot_pgx_effects and ot_pgx_compared_alleles. "NA" when no variantAnnotation; an item without value → NA inside the joined string.

common_properties.name: ot_pgx_gene_ids
common_properties.description: Gene identifiers supplied by the pharmacogenomic source as bare Ensembl IDs.
common_properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index i refers to the same entry. Missing text values → "NA".

common_properties.name: ot_pgx_pubmed_ids
common_properties.description: PubMed identifiers for literature supporting the pharmacogenomic annotations.
common_properties.notes: All lists of one source have the same length and index i refers to the same entry. Fields that are themselves multi-valued within one entry are stored as one string with values joined by "|", in source order. Missing text values → "NA".

common_properties.name: ot_pgx_n_annotations
common_properties.description: Number of distinct ClinPGx clinical annotation identifiers supporting the association.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Evidence-source tags for the association; OpenTargets_PGx identifies the pharmacogenomic contribution.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the association was created or its properties last changed.

source_contributions.scope: Includes annotations with a variant ID or an rsID alone, including genotype-level rows such as homozygous-reference genotypes. Haplotype-only annotations are excluded. No evidence-level filter is applied. Only drugs with a ChEMBL ID that correspond to an existing SPOKE Compound are included.
source_contributions.description: Each supporting entry represents a pharmacogenomic annotation for a drug. Evidence records the specific variant allele when provided; rsID-only entries retain their genotype-level annotation.
